Last year, Apple introduced a new feature called AutoMix on Apple Music. Coupled with this year's iOS 27, the feature has received a major upgrade, with transition effects that are more impressive than ever.

Apple Music AutoMix is on iOS 27

As a refresher, AutoMix uses artificial intelligence to create DJ-like mixing effects between songs on Apple Music. Apple says the initial version employed techniques like "time-stretching and beat-matching" to achieve perfect transitions.

While AutoMix in iOS 26 was already quite impressive, most of its transitions tended to follow a very similar — even predictable — style.

Apple says that in iOS 27, AutoMix "adds a whole new layer of energy and excitement, with better transitions that make for a more immersive, engaging listening experience".

Based on my own testing, Apple's claims hold up. The AutoMix transitions are smoother and more natural than ever, with a stronger DJ feel. The default "underwater" sound effect from iOS 26 has largely been replaced by more natural transitions that can blend one song into the next more seamlessly.

AutoMix in iOS 27 will even remix the endings and beginnings of songs, perfectly aligning the rhythm of transitions. It also replays parts of the endings and beginnings to serve as a bridge for transitions. The overall experience is genuinely more immersive than before.

There's also good news: with this year's software updates, AutoMix will also be coming to Apple Music for tvOS and HomePod.

9to5Mac's Take

AutoMix is a somewhat controversial feature, with people firmly in either the love-it or hate-it camp. Some people simply don't care for its various transition styles, which is understandable.

However, personally, I find the feature genuinely interesting, especially when playing music at social gatherings or parties.

I really enjoy listening to how Apple Music transitions from one song to another, especially when the two tracks have completely different styles. I think it adds an interesting new element to the listening experience.

iOS 27 is now available for public beta testers to download. It will be officially rolled out to all users later this year.

What do you think of Apple Music's AutoMix feature? Have you noticed the improvements in iOS 27? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
